title: The Family Vice
writer: Cesare Frugoni, Marino Onorati, Gianfranco Couyoumdjian
actors: Edwige Fenech, Renzo Montagnani, Juliette Mayniel
plot: Dying industrialist's family competes for inheritance through deceit. Ex-convict butler hired by half-sister undermines wife, pretends homosexuality. Women try seducing him. Twist reveals power dynamics after industrialist's death.
